retrievalProfile.description: A bright, high-contrast outdoor group portrait featuring oversized, vertically stretched yellow sans-serif typography layered with aggressive red brush-style secondary text.
excludeWhen: muted or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant outdoor scene featuring three men in casual summer attire, anchored by massive, vertically elongated yellow block lettering that dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame, overlaid with jagged red script.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography layered over subjects to create depth
High-contrast lighting between bright sky and textured stone
Primary color clash between yellow, red, and lime green
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects' presence
coreInvariants: Jagged, distressed red secondary lettering with black outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a diagonal line from top-left to mid-right, occupying the upper half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow 'BAHA MEN' text block centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subjects' faces, move down to the large yellow text, and follow the red script across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects, architecture, and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime Green and Sky Blue (Subject clothing and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements with hard, direct sunlight shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters have very small counters due to vertical stretching
The 'M' and 'N' have sharp, blocky terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact contrast between rigid geometric block letters and chaotic organic brush script.

preserve: Vertical stretch of the main title
Distressed edges of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed skeleton for vertical stretching.
Captures the jagged, aggressive brush aesthetic of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a bright, high-contrast outdoor photograph of three men in casual summer clothes (lime green shirt, grey shirt, shirtless) sitting on a white textured stone wall in front of a light blue house under a clear sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically stretched yellow block letters in the center. Overlap this with jagged, distressed red brush-style text featuring a thick black outline.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow text significantly stretched vertically?
Does the red text have a jagged, hand-painted appearance?
Is the lighting bright and characteristic of direct sunlight?
Are the colors saturated and vibrant?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical stretch on primary text
Intensity of distress on secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any specific brand logos on clothing
Exact phrasing of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is the largest element in the composition.
Verify the red text is legible despite its distressed texture.
Check that the subjects are not obscured by the text in a way that loses the 'group portrait' feel.
Confirm the vertical stretch does not distort the letters into illegibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Outdoor Group Portrait] + [Vertically Stretched Yellow Block Type] + [Distressed Red Brush Script Overlay]
